title: Mar Zutra Rabbah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 50a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.50a.12) and [Beitzah 8a](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.8a.7): “Mar Zutra expounded in the name of Mar Zutra Rabbah.” Hyman considers it very likely that what we find in [Menachot 35b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.35b.7) — “Rav Ashi was sitting before Mar Zutra; his tefillin strap turned over. (Rav Ashi) said to him, ‘Does the Master not hold that their beauty is outward?’ He said, ‘It did not occur to me’” — is Mar Zutra Rabbah. Hyman suggests that possibly this Mar Zutra is the one who spoke in Rav Huna’s name in [Eruvin 41b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.41b.4).[^2]

notes.text: Saved Davidson Eruvin 41b fully names Rav Huna. Hyman’s very-likely identification and further possible identification remain separate conjectures; no identity merge is performed.

[Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1095&lang=en) cites the identical Mar Zutra to Mar Zutra Rabbah formula in Shabbat and Beitzah. Menachot has Mar Zutra without “Rabbah”; Eruvin gives Mar Zutra transmitting in Rav Huna’s name. Hyman presents the first proposed identification as very likely and the second as possible.
